question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 7.
solution:
The correct answer is '**direct**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence expresses a desire for a straight or uninterrupted connection to key points like Metro stations, railway stations, etc.
 
• The appropriate adjective should indicate an unmediated or straightforward link.
 
• "**Direct**" fits well as it signifies a straight and uninterrupted connection, aligning with the context of the sentence.
 
• Other options ("**successive**", "**upright**", "**consecutive**") do not match the intended meaning or context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Days after Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Ghaziabad priority **section__** of the Delhi-Meerut Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS), the **__residents__** of high-rise societies in the National Capital Region called for direct **__connectivity__** to the public transport service points. The residents in **__many__** areas of Noida and Ghaziabad said they would be forced to continue **__depend__** on private vehicles without proper connectivity to the RRTS and **__other__** public transport modes. "The RRTS is a great development; we want **__direct__** connectivity to key points like Metro stations, railway stations, Delhi, and the RRTS. **__Without__** any proper public transport, many residents are forced to opt **__for__** a personal car," the president of the New Era Flat Owners Welfare Association, Abhishek Kumar,**__stated__**. The 17-km priority section of the Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut RRTS corridor was inaugurated by PM Modi on October 7, and it started commercial operations on the next day.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Successive (वान्छित): "Successive" means following in order or sequence, which isn't the intended meaning here.
 
• Upright (सीधा): "Upright" pertains to being vertical or morally righteous, unrelated to the context.
 
• Consecutive (लगातार): "Consecutive" means following continuously, which doesn't fit the context of providing a direct link.
